name: Lightleak
author: E. T. Carter
description: Film fogged by light leaking into the camera: broad soft blooms bleed in from the frame edges, near white against the edge, cooling through the warm pole into the cool pole as they feather into a dark emulsion base. Long thin anamorphic streaks stretch across the frame from soft bright sources, breaking and flickering along their length, and a halation glow sits under everything. The leaks breathe and slide along their edges; slow and cinematic.

params.label: Leak
params.effect: Strength of the light bleeding in from the edges; 0 leaves only the streaks on dark film.

params.label: Streaks
params.effect: Brightness of the anamorphic horizontal flares and their sources; 0 removes them.

params.label: Burn
params.effect: How far the hottest part of each leak burns toward white; low keeps it saturated colour.

params.label: Spread
params.effect: How deep the leaks reach into the frame; high floods most of it with light.

params.label: Speed
params.effect: Pace of the sweep, breathing and flicker; 0 holds one frame of film.
